verdict.rationale: Mastra Code's docs list a first-party recurring-prompts feature that can be created, run, paused, resumed, or deleted, which directly addresses recurring jobs. However, it rests on a single line with no detail on how schedules are defined. Headless `--prompt` runs are one-off executions, not recurring schedules, so they add no credit here. Missing for 10: documented schedule definition (cron/interval syntax), details on how scheduled runs execute and report results, support for scheduling multi-step workflows beyond prompts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
